pages.text:
File 1
Listening 1
Receptionist Good morning.
Dan
Hello. We’re from Computer International. We have
a reservation.
Receptionist OK. What are your names?
Dan
My name’s Dan Hughes and this is Jenny Carr.
Receptionist How do you spell your surname, Mr Hughes?
Dan
My surname? It’s Hughes. H-U-G-H-E-S.
Receptionist Sorry?
Dan
Hughes. H-U-G-H-E-S.
Receptionist OK. Thank you. And how do you spell your
surname, Miss Carr?
Jenny
Er … it’s C-A-double R.
Receptionist C-A-double R?
Jenny
Yes.
Receptionist OK. Where are you from? Are you English?
Dan
No, I’m not. I’m from the USA.
Receptionist Oh. OK. Are you English, Miss Carr?
Jenny
Yes, I am. I’m from London.
Receptionist Thank you. You’re in room seven.
Jenny
Room seven?
Receptionist Yes. And you’re in room 15, Mr Hughes.
Dan
Room 15. OK. Thank you.
Receptionist Thank you.
